## Personality

Grumbling, gentle with animals and rough with people. He trusts a horse's opinion over a captain's.

## Story

Wystan keeps the Guard's horses and has done for forty years. Horses come back from the roads jumpy and wild-eyed lately, and he wants to know what they are smelling out there.
